name: je-parish-rates
description: Jersey annual parish and island-wide rates reference for the 2026 rateable year. Covers assessed rateable quarters, domestic and non-domestic use, separate owner and occupier liability, furnished lettings, published parish rates, demands, returns, assessment reviews and appeals. Use for Jersey property rates, foncier rates, occupier rates, rates bills or changes of property ownership. Includes conditional calculations and source checks for exemptions, supplementary rates and rounding. Requires the actual assessment, applicable period sources and a qualified reviewer before an engagement amount. This source-cited draft does not determine a property's rateable value, submit returns or certify a complete Jersey tax pack.
